findings: Position, velocity and id are captured by native beforeForces callbacks at the indexed step; these are the quantities used for current geometry and member checks.

The ForceSaver forces channel is populated at beforeIntegration. At the step-0 dump it has no initialized physical force sample. Subsequent native HDF5 force samples are lagged; do not use them to claim same-step force causality.

The current area, volume, D, angle, WLC and member conclusions do not use this uninitialized step-0 force channel. Initial bending-stress evidence uses the separate archived static native force probe after force evaluations.

The force entries in the A5 native pre-bounce failure trace have their own scheduling meaning: local object forces have been cleared before bounce to accumulate reactions. Zero there does not imply zero membrane force before integration.
qualification: No full shear endpoint or matched-material speedup
